subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - FastApp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@fastapp.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fastapp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - follow up from demo

Hi Jane / Tom,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through FastApp's use case. Quick recap + a few follow-ups so we can finalize a hosted pricing proposal: 

Call recap (high-level)
- Use case: in-app assistant + transactional generation for support workflows.
- Key constraints: low latency for peak traffic, data residency in US, enterprise SSO.
- Success metric: cost per active user and predictable monthly spend.

To finalize pricing, can you confirm the following (estimates are OK):
1) Expected monthly token volume (input + output), or a breakdown by feature (assistant vs notifications).
2) Peak TPS (requests/sec) and if you expect short bursts vs sustained peaks.
3) Target budget range (monthly) and any internal target $/1M tokens you need us to hit for the model to be viable.
4) Any procurement constraints (PO timing / contract length).

I've attached our hosted pricing sheet — it shows list/unit pricing and pilot credit options. Based on the demo, rough next steps: once we have your token volumes + TPS we can size a recommended plan (standard hosted vs dedicated), estimate monthly cost, and propose a 2-week pilot with load testing scheduled by our SRE.

Can you share the numbers by end of week? Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if it's easier.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0143
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.pdf

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@fastapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@fastapp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - FastApp

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. Below are the estimates we discussed; they're still rough but should be enough for a sizing/pricing exercise.

Estimated usage (monthly)
- Assistant (conversational flows): ~20M tokens (avg 6 turns / session, ~200 tokens per session).
- Notifications & short-generation (templated): ~40M tokens.
- Total estimated monthly tokens: ~60M tokens/month (input + output combined).

Peak traffic
- Peak TPS: ~45 TPS (short bursts up to ~60 TPS during peak marketing events). Sustained peak ~30–40 TPS for 10–20 minute windows.

Budget & unit economics
- Target monthly budget: $6k–$12k initially.
- Internal target: ~ $100 / 1M tokens (this is the threshold our finance team wants to see to greenlight scale).

Other notes
- We need US-only data residency for the pilot and SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement: standard vendor onboarding; likely a single PO and 30–45 day payment terms.

If those numbers look feasible on your side, let's proceed with the sizing and a pilot plan. I'll loop in procurement after we have an estimate.

Best,
Jane
Director of Product, FastApp
jane.doe@fastapp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@fastapp.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fastapp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - FastApp

Jane — this is perfect, thanks for the detail. Quick notes / proposal based on your numbers: 

1) Cost estimate (hosted API)
- Using your target of ~60M tokens/mo and $100 / 1M tokens, expected monthly run-rate = ~$6,000 (fits your lower bound).
- If sustained growth reaches 200M tokens/mo we'll revisit volume discounts and/or recommend Dedicated.

2) Peak capacity / SLOs
- Your peak ~45 TPS (bursts to 60 TPS) is within our hosted tier for short bursts; we'll run a pre-pilot load test to validate tail latency.

3) Next steps
- I'll prepare a formal pricing estimate and SOW for the pilot.
- Sean (cc'd) will own the performance/load test plan and schedule a 1-hour run during a representative traffic window.
- I'll loop in our compliance team for SOC2 evidence and provide a data residency attestation.

Pilot proposal: 2-week hosted pilot with up to 100M tokens of test traffic included and a short SLA for latency during the pilot. We can adjust based on load test results.

Can you confirm the preferred start week for the pilot? Also share any procurement lead times so I can align contracts.

Thanks — will send the pricing estimate + SOW by EOD today.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0143

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.pdf

Thanks — I'll draft the load test plan and share the runbook (attaching redwood-loadtest-plan.md).
Short note: we'll simulate 1) steady 40 TPS for 20 minutes, 2) burst to 60 TPS for 5 minutes, and 3) a ramp to 80 TPS for a brief safety check (not expected in production but useful to characterize degradation).

I'll propose time slots for next week.
